evidence.note: after the curated RVV linear kernel landed, the elementwise elu ops became 40% of the model; they are pure memory traffic between two matmuls and are the obvious fusion target

advice.rationale: elu_s8 is 40% of measured runtime and each instance exists only to rewrite a tensor between two linear_s8 calls. Fusing each linear->elu pair removes an intermediate materialisation per layer.
